claim: In the matching retail DLL, four small FormAnimator form-query helpers are exact and mechanically distinct. IsAnmComplete (0x06004E79, 69 bytes) returns true only when FormDispDuration <= 0, isAnmBoot is set, and currentFormIdx is at least CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx].formNum-1. IsLastForm (0x06004E7A, 55 bytes) returns true only when isAnmBoot is set and currentFormIdx equals formNum-1. IsPrevLastAnmFrame (0x06004E7B, 69 bytes) uses the same terminal-form test as IsAnmComplete but requires FormDispDuration <= 1. GetCurrentFormDispInfo (0x06004E7C, 117 bytes) returns null when CurrentSkill is absent, CurrentAnmIdx is negative or outside anmData, or currentFormIdx is negative or outside formDispList; otherwise it returns CurrentSkill.anmData[CurrentAnmIdx].formDispList[currentFormIdx]. The already-closed UpdateAnimation and PlayAnimationSE methods call this exact GetCurrentFormDispInfo helper at their pinned call sites.
